data.name: Hardin
data.long_meaning: The name Hardin is derived from the Old English words ‘heard’ meaning ‘brave, hardy, strong’ and ‘ing’ meaning ‘son of’. This name was popular among the Anglo-Saxon and Norman people, and was often given to sons to reflect their strength and courage.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing inner strength and unwavering faith.
data.numerology_meaning: Number 3 represents creativity, self-expression, and communication.
